note: Adversarial / negative test vectors for @shieldfive/crypto v1. A conforming decoder MUST reject every result:"invalid" vector and MUST accept every result:"valid" control. Every vector here is self-checked against the reference implementation at generation time. Keys/file_ids/plaintext are fixed; see tests/vectors/generate-adversarial.ts.

aes-gcm-v1.comment: magic[0] flipped; must be refused before any crypto op (FORMAT_MAGIC_LENGTH=5)
flags byte set to 0x01; reserved flags must be rejected during header parse
suite byte set to an unassigned id (0x7f); must not fall back to a default
suite byte changed to another valid suite (0x04); defeated by the header MAC over the suite byte
first file_id byte flipped; MAC-authenticated and mixed into chunk-key/nonce derivation
low byte of total_chunks flipped; MAC-authenticated + cross-field consistency checked
low byte of plaintext_size flipped; MAC-authenticated + cross-field consistency checked
last header_mac byte flipped; header MAC verification must fail
low byte of chunk 0 length prefix flipped; reframes the chunk stream
first ciphertext byte of chunk 0 flipped; AEAD tag must fail
last byte (AEAD tag) of chunk 0 flipped; AEAD verification must fail
chunks 0 and 1 swapped; per-chunk AAD binds the chunk index, so reorder must fail
final chunk removed; the final-chunk flag / total_chunks binding must reject the short stream
chunk 1 replaced with chunk 1 from a different file_id (same key); file-bound chunk-key/nonce must reject it
untouched baseline; a conforming decoder must ACCEPT and recover the plaintext
